title: Journal OCR Correction Backlog
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:journal journal_name=* ocr_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(ocr_state!="corrected",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by journal_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending OCR corrections backlog by journal for journal digitization.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside journal digitization.
implementation: Mark each `memory:journal` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `journal_name`.
visualization: Table of journal with pending OCR corrections counts.
grandmaExplanation: It flags where unfinished OCR corrections are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in journal digitization.
